items.situation: friend sharing news about a classmate transferring
items.speaker: Where'd you hear that Mia's transferring?

options.B: Transfer applications are due in March.
options.C: I need to return these library books.
options.D: Just a couple of days ago.

items.explanation: 朋友惊讶地问「你从哪儿听说Mia要转学的」。正确答案A用惯用语「word travels fast」（消息传得快）自然地回应，含蓄承认消息已经传开，是地道的口语反应。B是语义联想陷阱：抓住「transfer」联想到转学申请截止日期，却答非所问。C完全离题，是另一段对话里才成立的话。D是问题类型错误：说话人问的是「在哪儿（where）听说的」，这句却回答了「什么时候（when）」。

items.situation: friend inviting another to a review session
items.speaker: Are you coming to the review session tonight?

options.A: The session room's on the second floor.
options.B: Actually, I've got a shift then.
options.C: I finally fixed my bike yesterday.
options.D: No, I've never been good at chemistry.

items.explanation: 朋友邀请对方今晚来复习课。正确答案B以话语标记词「Actually」开头，间接地用「我那时候要上班」委婉说明来不了，既回应又推进对话。A是语义联想陷阱：抓住「session」联想到教室楼层，却没回应邀请。C完全离题。D虽然带「No」，但理由（我从来不擅长化学）与「今晚是否来」毫无关系，属于错误语境。

items.situation: student asking about the reading list for a course
items.speaker: Do you know the reading list yet?

options.B: The parking lot's completely full today.
options.C: Well, it's posted on the course page.
options.D: Yes, I know a few people in that class.

items.explanation: 同学问「你知道阅读书单了吗」。正确答案C以话语标记词「Well」开头，间接地指出书单已发布在课程页面，正面解决了对方的信息需求。A是语义联想陷阱：抓住「reading」联想到睡前阅读的个人爱好，答非所问。B完全离题。D利用了「know」的多义性——这里的「know」是「认识几个人」而非「知道书单」，是典型的多义词误导，且没有给出任何书单信息。

items.situation: friend suggesting they get dinner together
items.speaker: Why don't we grab dinner this weekend?

options.B: My phone's been acting up lately.

items.explanation: 朋友用「Why don't we...」提出周末一起吃饭的建议。正确答案D直接答应并给出具体时间「周六可以」，是对建议最自然的正面回应。A是语义联想陷阱：抓住「dinner」联想到工作日更便宜，却没回应建议。B完全离题。C是问题类型错误：对方是在约饭，这句却回答了「作业是否做完」这种完全不同的问题。

items.situation: rescheduling an appointment with a receptionist
items.speaker: Can we push my appointment to Friday?

options.A: I'll check the calendar and text you.
options.B: Fridays are always so busy here.
options.D: I can't push the door open.

items.explanation: 对方问能否把预约改到周五。正确答案A没有生硬地回答「行/不行」，而是转向解决底层需求——「我查一下日程再发消息给你」，这正是context_shift范式。B是语义联想陷阱：抓住「Friday」谈周五有多忙，回避了改期请求。C完全离题。D利用「push」的多义性——把「push（改期）my appointment」误读成「push（推）the door」，是多义词误导。

items.situation: coordinating an airport pickup with a friend
items.speaker: I've still gotta get from the airport Sunday.

options.A: The airport added a new terminal.
options.B: Say no more, I've got you.
options.C: I finally finished my history essay.
options.D: I can't get the jar open.

items.explanation: 朋友说周日还得想办法从机场回来。正确答案B用惯用语「Say no more, I've got you」（不用多说，包在我身上）主动揽下接机，是地道又贴心的回应。A是语义联想陷阱：抓住「airport」谈机场新航站楼，却没帮上忙。C完全离题。D利用「get」的多义性——把「get（回来）from the airport」误接成「get（拧开）the jar」，是多义词误导。

items.situation: calling a shop to check its business hours
items.speaker: How late are you open on Sundays?

options.B: My car wouldn't start this morning.
options.C: Actually, we're open around the clock.
options.D: We're right next to the bank.

items.explanation: 顾客打电话问周日营业到多晚。正确答案C以「Actually」开头，用惯用语「around the clock」（全天候）间接告知全天营业，自然又切题。A利用「open」的多义性——把「open（营业）」误读成「open（打开）the window」，是多义词误导。B完全离题。D是问题类型错误：对方问的是「营业到多晚（时间）」，这句却回答了「在哪儿（位置）」。

items.situation: complaining to a neighbor about late-night noise
items.speaker: The music next door's kept me up again.

options.A: That band's new album is great.
options.B: The recycling gets picked up Tuesdays.
options.C: The door lock keeps getting stuck.

items.explanation: 邻居抱怨隔壁的音乐又害他没睡好。正确答案D没有停留在附和抱怨，而是转向解决问题——「我今晚去跟他们说说」，正是context_shift范式。A是语义联想陷阱：抓住「music」谈某乐队的新专辑，答非所问。B完全离题。C利用「door」的多义性——把「next door（隔壁）」误接成「the door lock（门锁）」，是多义词误导。

items.situation: student checking the last shuttle time
items.speaker: What time's the last shuttle back tonight?

options.A: Actually, it stops running at ten.
options.B: The shuttle got a new paint job.
options.C: I lost my student ID somewhere.
options.D: It leaves from the main gate.

items.explanation: 学生问今晚末班校车是几点。正确答案A以话语标记词「Actually」开头，间接给出「十点停运」这一关键信息，切题又自然。B是语义联想陷阱：抓住「shuttle」谈校车重新喷漆，答非所问。C完全离题。D是问题类型错误：对方问的是「几点（时间）」，这句却回答了「从哪儿发车（地点）」。

items.situation: classmate asking to borrow lecture notes
items.speaker: When's a good time to grab your lecture notes?

options.A: My notes are a total mess.
options.B: You can grab them after class.
options.C: The vending machine ate my money.

items.explanation: 同学问什么时候方便来拿讲义笔记。正确答案B直接给出时间「下课后就能拿」，是对「什么时候（when）」最自然的正面回答。A是语义联想陷阱：抓住「notes」谈自己的笔记很乱，没回答时间。C完全离题。D是问题类型错误：对方问的是「什么时候（时间）」，这句却回答了「在哪儿（笔记在蓝色文件夹里，即位置）」。
